summary: In this brief talk, Jeanne Bliss presents a coaching-centered approach to transforming organizations around customer experience. She argues that growth and profitability arise when leaders and employees focus on improving customers’ lives, create emotional bonds with customers, and empower staff by removing heavy management oversight. She contrasts coaching with traditional consulting—emphasizing immediate, actionable work and skin-in-the-game leadership—and describes how culture that honors customers can accelerate growth, loyalty, and advocacy. The talk blends practical stance on leadership with a vision of customer love as a strategic, if irrational-seeming, business driver.
title: Jeanne Bliss on Coaching for Customer-Driven Growth and Customer-Centric Leadership
topics: acting with intent in the marketplace
